brief.headline: Private credit gains ground in Asia amid AI boom
bullets: Private Credit: Private credit is gaining ground in Asia as demand for flexible capital grows and the AI boom needs funding, according to KKR.

M&A & Buyouts: Blackstone-backed Aster DM Quality Care is in talks to acquire hospitals in northern India from rival Narayana Hrudayalaya in a deal that could be worth up to $150m, according to a report by Bloomberg.
Hotels & Hospitality: Diriyah has canceled a $191 million hotel contract and won’t say why.

Infrastructure & Energy: KKR has made a minority investment in the Indian renewables platform of Petronas-backed Gentari, providing growth capital for its expansion in the country, according to a report by the Wall Street Journal.
Fed & Rates: Federal Reserve official Cook spoke on “The U.S. Economy in Global Context” at the XXIX Annual Conference of the Central Bank of Chile, Santiago, Chile.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: signals are mixed, with some markets calm and others showing strain, so expect selective risk-taking. The S&P 500 stands at 7,175.83 (down 2.0% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 28.4, an elevated reading that signals nervous markets. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.07% (down 3 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.28 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.52%, near long-run norms (up 5 bps on the prior reading).
